sense_timing_definition: request_to_output_ns: local read OUT reaching 90 % (read 1) or 10 % (read 0) of VDD measured from the access request at 0.65 T, worst read cycle; output_deadline_margin_ps: distance to the 1.2 T data deadline; the validator samples 0.015 T earlier

rejected_ladders.description: First pass: 10T with a mux only, every class 200 ps above the shared ladder (budget-A/B). Second pass: 10T with or without a mux, rows 1800/2000/2400/3200/4400 ps (final-A/B/L, pd-Q1..Q4). Controls at the shared class in both passes.
